                                   Resolution 2021-09
                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
                              FOR
       FULL FUNDING OF GIRDWOOD EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICE (EMS)
                                        IN
            FIRST QUARTER REVISIONS 2021 AND IN FUTURE CONTRACT

WHEREAS, according to AMC16.95.015 “The municipal emergency medical service shall include an adequate number of health
professionals, allied health professionals and other health personnel with appropriate training and experience to provide emergency
medical services 24 hours a day within the municipality”; and

WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue Inc EMS services extend from Indian to the base of Turnagain Pass and within the
communities of Girdwood, Bird, Indian and Portage, under contract with the MOA; and

WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue Inc. Board of Directors have been in engaged in negotiations with the Anchorage Fire
Department for several years, and both entities have agreed that compensation increase for EMS services of $300,000 per year is
necessary to provide the level required by AMC 16.95.015; and

WHEREAS, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors is responsible to the taxpayers of the Girdwood Valley Service Area (GVSA),
ensuring the proper allocation of tax contributions for Fire Service within the Girdwood Valley;

THEREFORE, be it resolved that the Girdwood Board of Supervisors requests that the Anchorage Assembly approve full funding
increase of EMS services funding by $300,000 retroactive to January 1, 2021 to Girdwood Fire and Rescue in 2021 as part of the
Anchorage Areawide First Quarter Revisions; and

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that these good faith negotiations and compensation for EMS services in the amount of $507,500 are
reflected in the forthcoming contract between Girdwood Fire and Rescue and the Municipality of Anchorage.

PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 to 0 this 19th day of April 2021.





                                                            April 20, 2021
Eryn Boone, GBOS Fire Dept Chair                       Date
